question: A can do a certain work at the same time in which B and C together can do it. If A and B together can do it in 7 days and C alone in 9 days, then B alone can do it in ______ days.
solution:
**Given:**

A can do a certain work at the same time in which B and C together can do it.

A and B together can do it in 7 days, and C alone can do it in 9 days.

**Calculation:**

Let total work = LCM of 7 and 9 = 63

Efficiency of (A + B) = Total work / Time taken by (A + B) to complete the work.

Efficiency of A + B = 63/7 = 9
